overview_description.description: Rastro is a company that provides AI-powered tools for retail operations, specifically focusing on onboarding, cleaning, and launching thousands of SKUs at scale. Their platform is designed to help distributors facilitate and automate various aspects of retail catalog management. The company was founded by engineers from Shopify and Uber, indicating a strong technical background in building scalable solutions for the retail industry.
